items.title: Resume copy mat karo
items.detail: Committee ke paas resume already hai. SOP mein batao kyun aur kaise.

items.title: Quote se shuru mat karo
items.detail: Famous quotes sab likhte hain. Apni ek real story se shuru karo.

items.title: Har uni ko same SOP nahi
items.detail: Course, faculty aur fit ke hisaab se har SOP thoda customise karo.

items.title: Zor se padh ke check karo
items.detail: Jahan atko, wahan line chhoti karo. Simple English sabse strong hoti hai.

youtube.title: SOP likh rahe ho? Ye 4 galtiyan mat karna
youtube.description:
SOP mein sabse common galtiyan: resume copy karna, famous quote se shuru karna, har university ko same SOP bhejna, aur bina padhe submit kar dena.

Apni kahani, apne shabdon mein likho.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
